'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli invasion of Gaza]]
***Four people are killed and 40 others are trapped under rubble in an [[Israel]]i attack against a building in [[Sabra, Gaza|Sabra]], [[Gaza City]], Palestine, as the [[ceasefire]] agreement proposed by [[US president]] [[Donald Trump]] awaits approval by the [[Israeli cabinet]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/palestinian-reports-gaza-city-strike-traps-40-under-rubble/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
***Twenty-nine people are killed in Israeli attacks against [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]. [https://english.wafa.ps/Pages/Details/163210 (Wafa)]
**[[Gaza war peace plan]]
***The Israeli cabinet formally approves the ceasefire agreement, with the [[Israeli military]] given 24 hours to withdraw their troops to the agreed-upon line within Gaza. The [[Gaza war hostage crisis|hostage]] and prisoner releases are expected to begin in the coming days. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-hamas-hostages-trump-peace-plan-e3d0ce091be56cc29207e566ff1603af (AP)]
***US officials announce that 200 troops will be sent to Israel to run a civil-military coordination center established by [[U.S. Central Command]] to support and monitor the ceasefire deal, joined by members of the armed forces of [[Egypt]], [[Qatar]], [[Turkey]], and the [[United Arab Emirates]]. [https://apnews.com/article/mideast-gaza-israel-hamas-us-military-c19caf7b193dbb3bfaf056366f9e2369 (AP)]
*[[Afghanistan–Pakistan clashes (2024–present)|Afghanistan–Pakistan clashes]]
**[[2025 Afghanistan–Pakistan conflict]]
***The [[Pakistan Air Force]] carries out two [[airstrike]]s in [[Kabul]], [[Afghanistan]], targeting [[Pakistani Taliban]] leaders. [https://amu.tv/204448/ (Amu.tv)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**Seven Pakistani Taliban members and a [[Major (rank)|major]] are killed in a raid and ensuing [[shootout]] in [[Daraban Tehsil|Daraban]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], Pakistan. The [[Inter-Services Public Relations]] further reports that the security forces recovered a cache of weapons and ammunition, along with stating that the killed terrorists were actively involved in multiple attacks. [https://www.dailypioneer.com/2025/world/7-ttp-terrorists-killed-in-northwest-pakistan.html (Daily Pioneer)]
**Three tribal leaders from Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan, are abducted and killed by Pakistani Taliban militants. [https://www.ptinews.com/story/international/3-tribal-leaders-abducted-killed-by-militants-in-northwest-pakistan/2993966 (Press Trust of India)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[2025 Nobel Prizes]]
**[[Hungary|Hungarian]] novelist and screenwriter [[László Krasznahorkai]] wins this year's [[Nobel Prize in Literature]] "for his compelling and visionary oeuvre that, in the midst of apocalyptic terror, reaffirms the power of art". [https://edition.cnn.com/2025/10/09/style/laszlo-krasznahorkai-nobel-prize-literature-intl (CNN)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Argentina–United States relations]], [[Argentine monetary crisis]]
**[[US Secretary of the Treasury]] [[Scott Bessent]] announces that the [[United States]] has purchased [[Argentine peso]]s and has finalized a [[currency swap |currency swap framework]], adding that the US is prepared to provide assistance to [[Argentina]]'s economy, after ending four days of meetings with [[Ministry of Economy (Argentina)|Argentine economy minister]] [[Luis Caputo]]. [https://apnews.com/article/trump-bessent-argentina-milei-currency-swap-7432a188e57264f0e5f6c753ddc40879 (AP)]
*[[Serbia–United States relations]], [[United States government sanctions]], [[Russia–United States relations]]
**The [[United States Treasury Department]] issues sanctions against [[Naftna Industrija Srbije]], the primary [[petroleum]] producer and supplier in [[Serbia]], which is majority-owned by [[Russia]]n state company [[Gazprom]]. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-us-serbia-oil-sanctions-7e84f9d0ff3eab8421c6aa90e1f27903 (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Pacific typhoon season]]
**One person is killed in [[Oiso]], [[Kanagawa Prefecture]], [[Japan]], and hundreds of people are [[emergency evacuation|evacuated]] as [[2025 Pacific typhoon season#Typhoon Halong|Typhoon Halong]] makes landfall in the [[Izu Islands]]. [https://apnews.com/article/japan-typhoon-heavy-rain-flooding-d2d631f1e521d527f12a34021ea9d138 (AP)] [https://english.kyodonews.net/articles/-/62474 (Kyodo News)]
*[[2025 Azerbaijan–Russia diplomatic crisis]], [[Azerbaijan Airlines Flight 8243]]
**[[Russian president]] [[Vladimir Putin]] says that [[Air Defence Troops of the Russian Ground Forces|Russian air defense]] shot down [[Azerbaijan Airlines Flight 8243]] in December 2024, in his first admission of responsibility for the accident. [https://www.cnn.com/2025/10/09/europe/putin-azerbaijan-jet-crash-intl (CNN)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Trinidad and Tobago–Venezuela relations]], [[Trinidad and Tobago–United States relations]]
**The [[Attorney General of Trinidad and Tobago|attorney general of Trinidad and Tobago]] says that the United States has granted permission yesterday to [[Trinidad and Tobago|the country]] to negotiate a gas deal with [[Venezuela]] without facing [[U.S. sanctions during the Venezuelan crisis|U.S. sanctions]] related to its [[United States–Venezuela relations|relationship with Venezuela]]. [https://apnews.com/article/trinidad-us-gas-deal-venezuela-af2849a8cbf89b18a76c8d0bc7302850 (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Ecuador protests]], [[Economy of Ecuador]]
**The [[Ecuadorian Army]] deploys at least 5,000 personnel to [[Quito]] to "prevent [[vandalism]]" amid ongoing protests against [[President of Ecuador|President]] [[Daniel Noboa]] over the rise of price of [[diesel fuel]] due to end of subsidies. '''Sports'''
*[[2025 ATP Tour]]
**In tennis, [[Monaco|Monégasque]] player [[Valentin Vacherot]] defeats [[Holger Rune]] at the [[Shanghai Masters (tennis)|Shanghai Masters]] to become the lowest-ranked player on the [[ATP rankings]] to reach a [[ATP Masters 1000 tournaments|Masters 1000]] semi-final in 26 years, and the first Monégasque in history to do so. [https://www.independent.co.uk/sport/tennis/valentin-vacherot-holger-rune-shanghai-masters-result-b2842380.html (''The Independent'')] [https://www.atptour.com/en/news/rune-vacherot-shanghai-2025-qf (ATP)]
